subject: maths
question: A and B can do a piece of work together in 10 days, B and C can do the same work together in 15 days, while C and A can do the same work together in 20 days. In how many days can A, B and C do the same work, working together?
solution:
Given:

A and B can do a work in 10 days.

B and C can do the work in 15 days

C and A can do the work in 20 days.

Concept used:

Efficiency = 1/Time
